description: This file defines functions and types related to attaching channel information to results, creating empty result objects, and building adapters for sending messages or polls over channels. It handles result normalization and adapter creation for outbound messaging channels.

methods.name: export function attachChannelToResult<T extends object>(channel: string, result: T) { attachChannelToResult
methods.description: Attaches a channel label to a result object, returning a new object combining the channel info with the result.

methods.name: export function attachChannelToResults<T extends object>(channel: string, results: readonly T[])/ attachChannelToResults
methods.description: Maps over an array of results, attaching the same channel label to each using attachChannelToResult.

methods.name: export function createEmptyChannelResult( createEmptyChannelResult
methods.description: Creates a default OutboundDeliveryResult object for a specific channel, optionally overriding with provided partial data.

methods.name: export function createAttachedChannelResultAdapter(params: { createAttachedChannelResultAdapter
methods.description: Creates an adapter object with sendText, sendMedia, and sendPoll functions that attach channel info to their results.

methods.name: export function createRawChannelSendResultAdapter(params: { createRawChannelSendResultAdapter
methods.description: Creates an adapter with sendText and sendMedia methods that normalize raw send results into a standard shape.

methods.name: export function buildChannelSendResult(channel: string, result: ChannelSendRawResult) { buildChannelSendResult
methods.description: Converts a raw ChannelSendRawResult into a normalized object including channel, ok, messageId, and error.
